corrections.replace: - derive/([wfghkz])ei$/$1ie/  # ReRime: tei (忒) is a real syllable; typed tie must not also read tei
corrections.reason: The typo derivation turns tei into tie, so a correct tie (铁, 贴) silently also offers 忒 with no correction mark. It is the only one of the 38 typo derivations that collides with a real syllable.
corrections.evidence: Audit of all 38 typo derivations in wanxiang_full_pinyin.yaml (schema SHA-256 188326c8...): 1 real-syllable collision before, 0 after.

corrections.replace: translators: [punct_translator, rerime_dual_script_translator, table_translator@personal_t9]  # ReRime IME-545: ReRime's copy of librime's script translator (App build 63+)
corrections.reason: Nine-key tail completion (IME-532) lives in ReRime's own copy of librime 1.16.1's script translator, registered as rerime_dual_script_translator in the App and keyboard from App build 63 (IME-315). Without it the schema keeps librime's stock translator and the key below has no effect.
corrections.evidence: re_rime IME-530 diagnosis and IME-532 tail completion; ReRime nine-key.ranking-benchmark --tail-completion applies exactly this change to a runtime copy.

corrections.replace:
enable_completion: true  # ReRime IME-545: also complete a short last syllable when the digits read whole
  rerime_tail_completion: true
corrections.reason: librime completes a short last syllable only when the digits cannot be read as whole syllables, and on a phone pad they nearly always can (2, 3 and 6 are a, e and o), so 7443 never offers 是的 and 5468 shows 李牧 before 今天. ReRime's translator reads this key; App versions without it ignore it.
corrections.evidence: re_rime nine-key.ranking-benchmark (470 words): last1 top-1 51.1% -> 79.4%, top-3 61.7% -> 95.1%, absent 36.0% -> 0.2%; full top-1 97.4% -> 97.2% (re_rime IME-532 record).

corrections.replace:
- schema: wanxiang_t9
    - schema: wanxiang_xiaohe  # ReRime IME-554: profile v4 also deploys 小鹤双拼
corrections.reason: librime compiles and lists only the schemas in default.yaml's schema_list. v4 adds wanxiang_xiaohe after wanxiang_t9, so the build compiles its prism and a session that last used 小鹤 opens it directly instead of building 全拼 first (ReRime IME-548: about 110 ms of a cold 小鹤 start). v2 builds keep the file unchanged, so the v2 recipe hash and installed Apps are unaffected.
corrections.evidence: ReRime IME-548 hand-over: cold 小鹤 engine_start 142.6 ms with the schema listed, equal to cold 全拼 147-153 ms; about 110 ms more without.
